neutralBodyTopBasis: Visually located neutral rear brown bun crown at source y90, excluding lower belt basket/pestle. Back hair crown is the true standing body top.
manualRootReviewBasis: Visually reviewed all18 raw and native poses: both complete planted boot support silhouettes end at the recorded ground. Lower witness excludes robe hem and held prop tips. Between-boot root uses the actual support pair, not body/bbox recentering. One neutral crown-to-sole scale for all18frames.

rootReviewPolicy: Review source and native strip. Set neutralTopY to the actual crown/body top (exclude props), neutralBodyTopConfirmed=true and neutralBodyTopBasis. For every frame set rootX/rootY from both boots, bootPairSupportWitness=[left,top,right,bottom] covering both boot support bands, and manualRootBasis (or a shared manualRootReviewBasis). Run --render after edits, then explicit confirm with exact-hash visual assessment.
